title: Lead On, O King Eternal
lyrics_original: The day of march has come;
Thy tents shall be our home.
Thy grace has made us strong;
Till sin's fierce war shall cease,
For not with swords' loud clashing,
But deeds of love and mercy
Thy cross is lifted over us,
Lead on, O God of might.

bible_verses.english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

devotional.prayer_english: King Eternal, thank You for leading us with wisdom and surrounding us with Your grace. When the days ahead feel daunting, remind us that You have already gone before us and made us strong in Your mighty power. Grant us courage to step out in faith and follow wherever You call. May our lives reflect Your holiness and proclaim Your victory today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: As believers, we do not march into life's battles in our own strength, but under the banner of Christ, our victorious King. Through every season of quiet preparation, His grace has been steadily building our faith and equipping us for what lies ahead. This classic hymn invites us to step forward with courage, trusting that wherever He leads, His holiness and peace will ultimately prevail. May our hearts sing with joyful confidence today as we follow our Lord into every field of service.
